items.title: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
items.description: SoftBank shares plunged over 16% on Friday as Japanese and South Korean technology stocks fell sharply.

items.title: Commerce approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, Rep. Mast says
items.description: Members of Congress have pushed in the wake of the Jensen Huang scandal for legislation to tighten export controls on chip sales to China.

items.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
items.description: The core inflation figure — which strips out prices of food — was lower than the 2.3% expected by Reuters-polled economists.

items.title: Anthropic IPO: Investors who flip the stock may face brokerage penalty
items.description: Brokerage firms may put future IPO limits in place for investors who sell their Anthropic stake too soon.

items.title: AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure
items.description: AMD closed down over 7% after a short seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. AMD said it complies with U.S. law.

items.title: Anthropic was supposed to save the AI trade. What went wrong?
items.description: Technology stocks tanked despite one of the most hotly anticipated tech IPOs in years. Why Anthropic couldn't revive AI animal spirits.

items.title: California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion
items.description: The investigation by California Attorney General Rob Bonta comes on the heels of the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Congress passes bill to protect older investors from financial fraud
items.description: Both chambers of Congress have now approved the Financial Exploitation Prevention Act of 2025, which is aimed at protecting vulnerable investors from fraud.

items.title: Intuit to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion
items.description: Intuit is offloading a segment that has slowed down revenue growth, for less than a third of what it paid to acquire Mailchimp in 2021.

items.title: What Ron Johnson's 'Ponzi scheme' label gets wrong about Social Security, experts say
items.description: Social Security's trust funds face a looming shortfall. But AARP says Sen. Ron Johnson's description of the program as a "legal Ponzi scheme" is inaccurate.

items.title: Palo Alto stock jumps on earnings beat and company's big bet on securing open-weight models
items.description: Palo Alto Networks reported better-than-expected first-quarter results and inked a $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute

items.title: Amazon app warns New York of higher costs if Mamdani delivery law passes
items.description: Amazon has lobbied heavily against the proposed legislation, while New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani backed the bill earlier this year.

items.title: Kraken parent's acquisition of Tribe Capital flags new chapter in evolution of crypto exchanges
items.description: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is pushing into private markets with its purchase of venture capital and asset management provider Tribe Capital.

items.title: 3-step method to influence people and win them over, from a Stanford expert: ‘Your voice is like a muscle’
items.description: Stanford University communications lecturer Matt Abrahams teaches current and future leaders how to train their voices to be more engaging and persuasive.

items.title: S&P 500 heads for 6th straight decline. Plus, J&J advances two key products
items.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

items.title: Walmart hikes outlook as CEO tells CNBC retailer aims to keep prices low despite soaring fuel costs
items.description: Walmart said it saw strength with store-fulfilled pickup and delivery in its fiscal third quarter.

items.title: Trump bought Nvidia, Palantir, SpaceX in September as federal deals, White House ties grew
items.description: President Trump disclosed purchases of Nvidia stock, SpaceX debt and Tesla shares in September, alongside millions of dollars in other investments.

items.title: As Sanofi's Pompe drug shortage drags on, some patients struggle to access treatments
items.description: An ongoing shortage of Sanofi’s Pompe disease treatment is forcing some patients to miss critical doses. They worry their health is at risk.

items.title: Amid recent banking outages, should you start carrying cash again? Top advisors weigh in
items.description: Recent outages are prompting a rethink of cash. At the very least, your money should be diversified, top advisors say.

items.title: Jensen Huang's — and Nvidia's — legal exposure balloons
items.description: "It's not going to get any better for Jensen Huang; it's going to get far worse," said Salvatore Graziano, a New York securities litigation attorney.
